# Duolingo

> > The world's most popular language-learning platform, offering free courses in dozens of languages with gamified lessons, research-backed pedagogy, and educational tools.

Duolingo provides language education through mobile and web apps, featuring courses in major languages like German, Spanish, and French, as well as niche offerings. The platform combines educational research, AI-driven personalization, and community features like Duolingo for Schools and the Duolingo English Test.

## Key Topics

- Language learning pedagogy and methods
- Duolingo English Test
- Duolingo for Schools
- German language courses
- Speaking skills development
- Learning advice and tips
- Educational research and publications
- Gamification features
- Dear Duolingo advice column
- Language acquisition research
- Mobile and web app features
- Educational technology
- Multilingual education
